lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration along the posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form a repeating coordinate-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a vertical luminance transition from light to dark.
